solution:
Every symmetry of the large triangle fixes the central triangle, so its color can be chosen independently in 6 ways. Rotations and reflections realize all six permutations of the three corners. Thus two corner colorings are equivalent exactly when they have the same multiset of colors.

The six color counts at the corners are nonnegative integers summing to 3. By stars and bars, there are $\binom{3+6-1}{3}=\binom{8}{3}=56$ such multisets. Including the central color gives $6\cdot56=336$.
Final answer: 336
